Yosetsu Awase (Sports Festival).name: Yosetsu Awase (Sports Festival)
Yosetsu Awase (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Yosetsu Awase, hero name Welder, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival he was part of Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu's cavalry team, which fell short of the final tournament; Tetsutetsu and Ibara Shiozaki later took two places left by withdrawals. Black hair under a striped headband, gray eyes, a sturdy build; the U.A. uniform or his burgundy hero costume.
Speaking Style: Direct and informal; quick warnings.
Combat Role: Hands-on support who welds by touch to anchor, block or pin; nothing at range.
Under Pressure: Finds the practical bond in reach and accepts the referee's call.
Yosetsu Awase (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival rewarded spectacle; his best work is a quiet bond the cameras barely catch. Motivation: Show the watching pros that practical support matters. Connections: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, his cavalry captain, whose fighting spirit he admires. Knowledge: Knows the League of Villains' attack on 1-A at the USJ from the news. Thread: Whether a contact-only Quirk gets noticed.
QUIRK: Weld: quicker, surer bonds after a few weeks of training; still contact-only.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Welder.
personality: Helpful: Covers a teammate the moment a practical opening appears.
Pragmatic: Reads an arena for what can be joined, braced or anchored.
Careful bonder: Checks that a weld will not trap his own team.
Speaking style: Direct, informal warnings; short and practical, no speeches.
abilities: Weld: Fuses touched objects into one piece; contact only, no undoing from afar.
Capture weld: Fixes a restraint onto a target to pin them; he must reach them first.
Emergency bracing: Bonds loose material into a quick barrier, only as strong as the material.
Practical eye: Spots anchor points and what can be joined at a glance.
Fighting style: Works close to his team, welding obstacles and opponents in place for a teammate to finish.
Yosetsu Awase (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with black hair swept up and back under a striped headband, gray eyes, fair skin and a sturdy build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Upbeat, determined expression with a slight grin.
